title: for Loop Variations (4 Stages)
description:
Practice writing for loops across 4 distinct stages:
1. Use range(3) to print numbers 0, 1, 2.
2. Use range(1, 4) to print numbers 1, 2, 3.
3. Use range(10, 40, 10) to print 10, 20, 30.
4. Loop over ["A", "B"] and print each letter.
